text: Eating tool. Humans stabbed their food with it, then threw it away. They made billions of them.
Citizens fed coins to this box to park. When the time ran out, a stranger in uniform fined them.
This small piece of metal opened a person's home. Losing it ruined entire weekends.
Humans gathered here daily to say nothing. Forty-seven members. No one ever left.
Humans stared at this glowing rectangle six hours a day, then complained they had no time.
Humans secured their entire lives with the word 'password123' and were shocked when it failed.
Humans put food in this box, pressed 2:30, and stood watching it like a television.
A stick for taking pictures of oneself. Humans held it high and called the result a memory.
Do not touch. Visitors touched it anyway. This sign is the exhibit now.
Humans paid for water in a bottle, then paid again to throw the bottle away.
